# The program, 0dce654a8:tools/mali/board-ref/2026-10-19-preload/preload.c, mode
# strip: a 64x64 RGBA8 FBO; frame 1 clears it blue and draws red over
# columns 0-31; glFinish; frame 2 draws green over columns 16-47 without a
# clear, so it starts from frame 1's image; "not as predicted 0", rc 0, by
# tools/mali/mesa-board-ref.sh (PAN_MESA_DEBUG=linear,nocrc,dump,trace,sync):
#   mesa-strip: mesa-strip.pandecode sha256 960ddcc143d9bb8c553c18a9d0889179add685036880baddaa733c28d9cf1888
